s: li home । adane । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (ju॰-para॰-saka॰-aniw .) homo devatAsampradAnakavahnyaDikaraRakavastutyAgaH । li, juhoti GftamagnO kfzRAya hotA । prakzepe'pyayam । “cirAya santarpya samidBiragniM yo mantrapUtAM tanumapyahOzIt .” iti raGuH । “jawADaraH san juhuDIha pAvakam .” iti kirAte prIRanArTo'pi । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: hIme adane ca ju॰ pa॰ saka॰ aniw । juhoti ahOzIt jahAva । prIRane ca । “juhuDIha pAvakam” kirA॰ ।
m: 1. हु cl. 3. P. (Dhātup. xxv, 1) जुहोति (Ved. and ep. also Ā. जुहुते; 3. pl. pr. जुह्वति, ˚ते, RV. &c.; 2. sg. Impv. जुहुधि, Br. &c.; होषि, RV.; p. P. जुह्वत्; Ā. जुह्वान [also with pass. sense]; 3. pl. impf. अजुहवुः, ib.; pf. P. जुहाव, जुहुवुः, MBh.; Ā. जुहुवे, R.; जुह्वे, जुहुरे, RV.; जुह्विरे, Br.; जुहवां-चकार, ib.; Up.; जुहवाम्-आस, Vop.; aor. अहौषीत्, Br. &c.; Prec. हूयात् Gr.; fut. होता, ib.; होष्यति, ˚ते, AV. &c.; Cond. अहोष्यत्, Br.; inf. होतुम्, ˚तोस्, ˚तवै, and ind.p. हुत्वा, ib. &c.), to sacrifice (esp. pour butter into the fire), offer or present an oblation (acc. or gen.) to (dat.) or in (loc.), sacrifice to, worship or honour (acc.) with (instr.), RV. &c. &c.; to sprinkle on (loc.), Yājñ.; to eat, Vop. : Pass. हूयते (aor. अहावि), to be offered or sacrificed, RV. &c. &c.: Caus. हावयति (aor. अजूहवत्), to cause to sacrifice or to be sacrificed or to be honoured with sacrifice, GṛŚrS. &c.: Desid. जुहूषति, to wish to sacrifice, MBh.; R. : Intens. जोहवीति (impf. अजोहवीत् or अजुहवीत्, BhP.), जोहूयते, जोहोति (Gr.), to offer oblations repeatedly or abundantly.
हु [cf. Gk. χυ- in χέω (for χέϝω), χυλός, χυμός; Lat. fūtis, ‘water-pot’.]
2. हु ind. an exclamation in हुं हु, हूं हु &c., Sarasv.
हुं in comp. for हुम्.
a: हु — {c3c} P., (जुहोति, हुत; pass. हूयते; caus. हावयति-ते, desid. जुहूषति) 1 To offer or present (as an oblation to fire); make an offering to or in honor of a deity (with acc.); sacrifice; यो मंत्रपूतां तनुमप्यहौषीत् R. 13. 45; जटाधरः सन् जुहुधीह पावकं Ki. 1. 44; हविजुर्हुधि पावके Bk. 20. 11; Ms. 3. 87; Y. 1. 99. --2 To perform a sacrifice. --3 To eat.

m: हुंहुं-कार See under हुम्.
हुं—हुं-कार m. the exclamation हुं-हुम्, Lalit.
हुं—कारा (आ), f. N. of a Yoginī, Hcat.
हुं—कारी (ई), f. id. or N. of a similar being, Pañcad.
हुं-कार हुं-कृत &c. See हुम्.

हुं—कार m. the sound हुम् (esp. expressive of menace or contempt &c.; also applied to the trumpeting of an elephant, to the roaring or grunting &c. of other animals, to the twang of a bow &c.), MBh.; R. &c.
हुं—कार—गर्भ mfn. filled with groaning or menacing sounds, MW.
हुं—कार—तीर्थ n. N. of a Tīrtha, Cat.
हुं—√ कृ P. -करोति (ind.p. -कृत्य), to utter the sound हुम्, to hum, ŚārṅgP.; to address roughly, Yājñ.; to utter a sound of disgust at (acc.), Car. : Caus. -कारयति, to give vent to one's anger, MBh.

s: klI, (huM ityavyaktaSabdasya kftaM karaRam .) huNkAraH । iti DaraRiH ॥ (yaTA, BAgavate । 4 । 14 । 34 । nijaGnurhuMNkftErveRaM hatamacyutanindayA ॥”) vanyavarAhaSabdaH । iti kecit ॥ hu~ iti mantroccarite, tri ॥ (hu~ ityanena tiraskftaH । yaTA, mahABArate । 12 । 118 । 1 । “sa SvA prakftimApannaH paraM dEnyamupAgataH । fziRA huMkftaH pApastapovanabahiskftaH ॥” huNkftamasyAstIti । ac । huNkAraviSizwaH । yaTA bfhatsaMhitAyAM । 48 । 11 । “aciraprasUtahuNkftavalgitavatsotsave gozWe ॥”)
m: हुं—कृत mfn. roaring, bellowing, bleating, VarBṛS.
addressed roughly (v.l. हूं-कृत), MBh.
uttered with a mystical sound, pronounced as an incantation, MW.
हुं—कृत n. an exclamation of anger, R.; BhP.
roar (of thunder), lowing (of a cow) &c., Kāv.
an incantation, MW.

a: हुंड् — {c1c} A. (हुंडते) 1 To collect. --2 To select, choose.
हुंडः — 1 A tiger. --2 A ram. --3 A blockhead. --4 A village-hog. --5 A demon.

m: हुण m. N. of Viṣṇu, L.
हुण्ड् cl. 1. Ā. हुण्डते (accord. to Pāṇ. vii, 1, 58, Sch., also हुण्डति), to collect, accumulate, Dhātup. viii, 16; to select, choose, take (cf. √ भुण्ड्), ib. 24 (v.l.)
हुण्डा (आ), f. crackling (of fire), KāśīKh., Sch.
हुण्डी f. = prec. MW.

s: puM, vyAGraH । grAmyaSUkaraH । mUrKaH । rAkzasaH । iti kecit ॥
v: puMstrI॰ huqi--ac । 1 vyAGre 2 grAmyaSUkare 3 rAkzase ca striyAM NIz । 4 mUrKe bri॰ ।
m: हुण्ड m. a ram (cf. हुड), KāśīKh.
a tiger, L.
a village hog, L.
a blockhead, L.
a Rākṣasa, L.
(prob.) an ear (of corn), Siṃhās.
(pl.) N. of a people (v.l. पौण्ड्र), MBh.
हुण्डन m. N. of one of Śiva's attendants (cf. वि-हुण्डन), KāśīKh.
हुण्डन n. becoming benumbed or paralyzed, Car.
हुण्डनेश m. N. of Śiva, KāśīKh.
हुण्डि m. or f. a heap or lump of rice (= पिण्डित ओदनः), L.
हुण्डिका f. (Pers. هندي) a bill of exchange, bond, Rājat.
assignment or order (for the maintenance of soldiers), ib.
हुञ्जिका f. a partic. Rāga, Saṃgīt.
हुगलि, हुग˚ली, or हुगुलि, हुगु˚ली, f. N. of a town in Bengal (= Hūglī), Kṣitīś.
हुग्ग m. N. of a lexicographer, Cat.

m: हुहव or हुहुव m. a partic. hell (cf. हहव), Divyāv.

m: हुहु or हुहू or हूहु or हूहू, m. (nom. हुहूस् gen. हुहोस्), N. of a Gandharva, ŚāṅkhŚr.; MBh. &c.
a: हुहु(हू) — m. A kind of Gandharva.

m: हुक्-कार, m. the sound हुक् (supposed to be made by a drum), Inscr.
हुल् cl. 1. P. होलति, to go, Dhātup. xx, 14; to cover, conceal, ib.; to kill, ib.
a: हुल् — {c1c} P. (होलति) 1 To go. --2 To cover or conceal. --3 To kill.

m: हुलाग्रका f. a kind of weapon, L.

v: hatO saMvaraRe ca BvA॰ pa॰ saka॰ sew । holati aholIt jvalA॰ hulaH holaH ।
m: हुल m. a partic. kind of warlike implement (cf. हुड), MBh.
हुल n. a double-edged knife with two sharp edges, L.

a: हुलहुली — A kind of inarticulate sound, uttered by women on joyful occasions.

m: हुल—मात्रिका f. a long dagger, L.
हुलिङ्ग m. N. of a country belonging to Śālva in Madhya-deśa, L.
हुलिहुली f. nuptial music, L.
roaring, howling, Mṛcch. viii, 28/29.
हुल्ल n. (in music) a kind of dance, Saṃgīt.
हुल्लुर m. N. of a king of the Nāgas, Kāraṇḍ.
हुलु m. a ram (cf. हुडु), L.
हुलुहुल mfn. (fr. √ हुल्), L.
हुलुहुलु ind. an exclamation of joy, L.

s: vya, (hUyate iti । hu + bAhulakAt maH .) smftiH । apAkftiH । arTapraSnaH । aByanujYA । iti medinI ॥ tarke vitarke hU~ Sabdo dIrGAdihraKAdirapIti kecit । ityamarawIkAyAM BarataH ॥
v: avya॰ hu--qumi । 1 smaraRe 2 praSne 3 anujYAyAM ca 4 nivAraRe medi॰ । “guruM huNgftya tuNkftyeti” smftiH ।
m: हुम् or हूम्, ind. or हुम् an exclamation (of remembrance, doubt, interrogation, assent, anger, reproach, fear &c., not translatable); a mystical syllable used in spells and magical texts or sentences; in Vedic ritual used immediately before the singing of the Prastāva or prelude as well as during the chanting of the Pratihāra or response, ŚrS.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: हुम् — ind. A particle (originally an imitative sound) expressing 1 Remembrance or recollection; हुं ज्ञातं or रामो नाम बभूव हुं तदबला सीतेति हुम्. --2 Doubt; चैत्रो हुं मैत्रो हुं. --3 Assent; U. 5. 35. --4 Anger. --5 Aversion. --6 Reproach. --7 Interrogation. (In spells and incantations हुं is often found used with dat.; e. g. ओं कवचायहुम्). (हुंकृ means ‘to utter the sound hum’, ‘to roar, grunt, bellow, as in अनुहुंकृ ‘to roar in return;’ अनुहुंकुरुते घनध्वनिं न हि गोमायुरुतानि केसरी Śi. 16. 25.). --Comp. --कारः --कृतिः f. {1} uttering the sound ‘hum’; पृष्टा पुनः पुनः कांता हुंकारैरेव भाषते. {2} a menacing sound, sound of defiance; क्षतहुंकारशंसिनः Ku. 2. 26; हुंकारेणेव धनुषः स हि विघ्नानपोहति Ś. 3. 1, R. 7. 58; Ku. 5. 54. {3} roaring, bellowing in general. {4} the grunting of a boar. {5} the twang of a bow. --कृतं {1} an incantation. {2} the grunt of a wild boar. {3} the roar of thunder.

k.v: अलं भूषणपर्याप्तिशक्तिवारणवाचकम्. हुं वितर्के परिप्रश्ने समयान्तिकमध्ययोः॥
अलं भूषणपर्याप्तिशक्तिवारणवाचकम्. हुं वितर्के परिप्रश्ने समयान्तिकमध्ययोः॥
अस्ति सत्वे रुषोक्तावु ऊं प्रश्नेऽनुनये त्वयि। हुं तर्के स्यादुषा रात्रेरवसाने नमो नतौ॥

m: हुमाउं m. Humāyūn (emperor), Inscr.
हुम्भा f. = हम्भा, R. (B.)
हुम्—फड्-अन्त m. pl. (scil. मन्त्राः) mystical texts ending in the exclamations हुम् and फट्, MW.
हुम्मा ind. an interjection in a Sāman, PañcavBr.
हुन् (only in 3. sg. Pot. हुनेत्) = √ 1. हु, to sacrifice, Pañcar.; Hcat.
हुड् cl. 6. P. हुडति, to collect, accumulate (= √ हुण्ड्), Dhātup. xxviii, 102; to dive, sink, be submerged, ib.; cl. 1. P. होडति, to go (= √ होड्, हूड्), ib. ix, 70.
a: हुड् — {vI.v} {c1c} P. (होडति) To go. {vII.v} {c6c} P. (हुडति) 1 To collect. --2 To dive, sink.

s: i Na saMhe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰Atma॰-saka॰-sew .) i, huRqyate । Na, huRqate DanaM lokaH । rASIkarotItyarTaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
f Na gatO । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰Atma॰-saka॰-sew .) f, ajuhoqat । Na, hoqate । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
Si magne । saMhe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (tudA॰para॰-magne aka॰-saMhe saka॰-sew .) Si, huqati ahuqIt juhoqa । magnamiha majjanam । iti durgAdAsaH ॥

puM, (huqatIti । huqa + kaH .) mezaH । iti hemacandraH rAjanirGaRwaSca ॥ cOrAdinivAraRArTaBUminihitalOhamayatIkzRaSaNkuviSezaH ॥ tasya nAmAntaraM guqaH । pA~jikAwA iti BAzA । laguqaH । iti mahABAratam ॥ sEnyASrayasTAnam । vuruj iti BAzA । raTopari viRmUtratyAgaSfNgam । yaTA, -- “purI samantAdvihitA sapatAkA satoraRA । sacakrA sahuqA cEva sayantraKanakA taTA ॥” iti mahABArate vanaparbbaRi sOBavaGe 15 aDyAyaH ॥ patAkA DvajAYcalaH । toraRAni bahirdvArARi । cakrARi yoDagaRAH । huqAstadASrayasTAnAni । BAzAyAM varujsaMjYAni । anye tu viRmUtrotsarjjanaSfNgARi huqA ityAhuH । udAharanti ca । “kalpyante huqaSfNgARi raTasyopari sUriBiH । viRmUtrasparSaSudDyarTakarAdisparSa udyate ॥” iti ॥ yantrARi AgneyOzaDabalena dfzatpiRqotkzepaRAni । mahAnti kAmAnasaMjYAni kzudrARi sIsagulikotkzepaRAni bandukasaMjYAni । KanakAH suraNgadvArA guptamArgakarttAraH । iti tawwIkAyAM nIlakaRWaH ॥
v: rASIkaraRe saka॰ majjane saMGAte ca aka॰ tu॰ ku॰ pa॰ sew । huqati ahuqIt juhoqa fdit caNi na hrasvaH ।
rASIkaraRe BvA॰ A॰ saka॰ sew idit । huRqate ahuRqizwa ।
gatO BvA॰ A॰ saka॰ sew fdit caNi na hrasvaH hoqate ahoqizwa ।

pu॰ huqa--ka । 1 meGe hemaca॰ । cOranivAraRArTaM BUmO niKAte 2 lOhakIlake ca 3 senASrayasTAne 4 raGopari viRmUtratyAgArTasTAnaSfNge ca “purI samantAdvihitA mapatAkA satoraRA । sacakrA sahuqA cEva sayantraKanakA taTA” BA॰ va॰ 15 a॰ । “cakrARi yoDagaRAH huqAstadASramasTAnAni BAzAyAM (vuruja) saMjYAni । anTe tu viRmUtrotsarjanasTAnaSfNgARi huqA ityAhuH । udAharanti ca । “kalpyante huqaSfNgARi raTasyopari sUrimiH viRmUtrasparSaSudDyarTakarAdisparSa udyataH iti” nIlaka॰
m: हुड m. a ram, L.; VarBṛS. (v.l.)
a partic. implement of war, MBh.
a bar or iron rod for keeping out thieves, MW.
(accord. to some) a place for voiding excrement, ib.
a: हुडः — 1 A ram. --2 An iron stake for keeping out thieves. --3 A kind of fence. --4 An iron club. --5 A kind of bulwark or fence. --6 A place for voiding excrement on a chariot. --7 A cloud.

हुड्डुक v.l. for हुडुक्क.
हुडु m. a ram, L.
a: हुडुः — A ram; जंबुको हुडुयुद्धेन Pt. 1. 162.

हुडुक्का (आ), f. a kind of drum, Saṃgīt.
हुडुक्—कार m. (with Pāśupatas) a kind of chuckling, ib.

a kind of bird in rut (Gallinula Madraspatana = दात्यूह), L.
a drunken man, L.

the bar or bolt of a door, L.

the noise of a bull, L.

हुर्छ् (or हूर्छ्, prob. connected with √ ह्वृ) cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. vii, 31) हूर्छति (pf. जुहूर्छ fut. हूर्छिता &c. Gr.), to go crookedly, creep stealthily, totter, fall; to fall off from (abl.), MaitrS.; Kāṭh. : Caus. हूर्छयति, to cause to fall from (abl.), Kāṭh.
